description:
Perform an internal authority audit of 'https://books.toscrape.com/' using Screaming Frog's Link Score metric. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Configure 'Crawl Analysis' (Configuration > Crawl Analysis > Configure) to ensure 'Link Score' is enabled.
3. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
4. Once the crawl finishes, run the post-crawl analysis (Crawl Analysis > Start) to calculate the Link Scores. Wait for it to reach 100%.
5. Export the 'Internal' tab data to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/authority_audit.csv'.
6. Create a text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/top_authority_pages.txt' listing the Top 5 URLs by Link Score (highest to lowest) and their scores.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- An exported CSV exists with a populated 'Link Score' column (values > 0).
- A text report exists listing the top pages.
